watch.summary: The streamer expresses a total lack of faith in his team, but immediately erupts in hype when a teammate scores a goal right as he demands conviction.

beats.what: Creator admits he has zero confidence in his team or his own play.
Creator begs his team for power and conviction behind their shots.
A teammate scores a goal right on cue.
Creator screams in triumph, completely changing his tone.

watch.author: mixed
watch.why: The instant timing of the goal right as he begs for conviction creates a classic ironic flip. His rapid shift from hopeless complaining to explosive hyping makes the moment instantly funny.
